Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Interface OgcFilter

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface OgcFilter
A serializable OGC Filter predicate for use within SLD 1.0 <Rule> elements.

This interface represents a single OGC Filter expression node (comparison, spatial predicate, logical operator, or feature ID selector) that knows how to emit its own XML fragment. All concrete implementations are lambdas created by the factory methods in OgcFilters; callers never implement this interface directly.

Instances are composable via OgcFilters.and(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter...), OgcFilters.or(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter...), and OgcFilters.not(io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter) to build arbitrarily nested filter trees.

Usage


 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters.*;

 OgcFilter f = and(
     greaterThan("population", 1_000_000),
     like("name", "New*")
 );

 SldBuilder.create("cities")
     .rule("large-cities").filter(f)
         .point(WellKnownName.CIRCLE, "#FF0000", 10)
     .build();

  • Method Details

    • appendXml

      void appendXml(StringBuilder sb, String indent)
      Appends the OGC Filter XML fragment for this predicate to sb.

      The fragment should be well-indented using indent as the prefix for the outermost element; child elements are indented relative to that. No surrounding whitespace is prepended before indent.

      Callers (typically SldBuilder internals) wrap the emitted fragment in <ogc:Filter>…</ogc:Filter>; this method emits only the inner content.

      Parameters:
      sb - the StringBuilder to append the XML fragment to; must not be null
      indent - the whitespace prefix for the outermost XML element (e.g. " ")
